card.name: Words for smooth, frictionless operation
card.fires_on: Words about things going smoothly, such as smooth, smoothly, fluid, flow, friction or running in phrases like 'keep things running smoothly'. It appears in general web text about operations, movement or transitions.

modes.label: Smooth operation
modes.description: Smooth or smoothly (or running before smoothly) describing a process or system that works without trouble.

modes.label: Frictionless movement
modes.description: Words for easy motion or flow, such as fluid, flow and friction, in physical or skill settings.
modes.example: until they become<< fluid>>, efficient and second nature.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning smooth, seamless and fluent, in English and Chinese.
